module: Flowgraph node "On Crash Detected" (category repeat_instant). Emits flow when a tracked vehicle starts or ends a crash (onVehicleCrashStarted/onVehicleCrashEnded hooks of gameplay_util_crashDetection). Outputs: startCrash, endCrash (pulses) and vehId. Simultaneous crashes are queued and output one per frame.

reset.desc: Empties the crashStartQueue and crashEndQueue queues.

work.desc: Pops one crash start and one crash end per frame and fills startCrash, endCrash, vehId.

onVehicleCrashStarted.desc: Hook: adds vehId to the crash start queue.

onVehicleCrashEnded.desc: Hook: adds vehId to the crash end queue.

notes: If a start and an end are output in the same frame, vehId is overwritten by the one from the end.
